newsitem.title: UK: Both Brent cargoes kept from chains - trade.
newsitem.headline: Both Brent cargoes kept from chains - trade.

text.p: The two Brent cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Monday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes, loading April 8-10, were kept by BP, which has kept the first 12 cargoes from the April loading programme.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
